title: Print & attach the bike tag
note: The tag carries a Code 128 job number for the shop’s own scanner. The bar pattern shown here is a non-scanning specimen: it is a placeholder, not a real encoding, and a generated scanner-verified barcode follows the printer and scanner proof (P00b). The readable job number stays as the fallback, and the layout keeps room for a QR if a shop later wants phone-camera scanning. Final label size, driver and customer-detail policy need physical shop validation. “Acknowledged” is a designed state, not evidence of a real print.

title: The mechanic’s job page
note: One page per job on a tablet or desktop: the agreement on the left, the work on the right, nothing hidden behind a tab. In portrait it becomes a single scrolling column. Replaces the former mechanic phone flow (open job, inspect, do the work, final check). The checklist comes from the service template. Marking ready is independent of custody and of payment: it does not mean collected, and it does not mean paid.
